parked.spanish: Y rodeará a ustedes el límite desde el Neguev a Maalé Aqrabim, y pasará a Tsin, y serán sus salidas desde el Neguev a Qadesh Barnéa, y saldrá a Hatsar Adar, y pasará a Atsmoná.

findings.issue: Niphal 3ms of H5437 turns or is turned; לָכֶם is to or for you. «rodeará a ustedes» makes the border surround the addressees.
H5045 is a common noun (south / south-country / Negeb), not a proper name. «Neguev» leaves it untranslated and closes the open sense as a place name.
לְמַעֲלֵה is a common noun in construct (ascent of); only עַקְרַבִּים is the proper name. «Maalé» is an untranslated common noun fused into the name.
Verbless clause (its outgoings from … to …). «y serán» adds an unmarked conjunction and an unmarked future copula.
H5045 is again a common noun left untranslated as the place name «Neguev».
חֲצַר אַדָּר has no preposition and no directional suffix. «a» is supplied so salir can take the place; Tsin and Atsmon are the tokens that mark direction.
The directional suffix is already carried by «a»; «Atsmoná» also keeps that he in the name.

parked.spanish: Desde Hor el monte señalarán a Lebo Jamat, y serán salidas del límite a Tsedadá.

findings.issue: לְבֹא is a proper noun, so the lamed belongs to the name Lebo. Unmarked “a” adds a destination the token does not mark.
3cp היה has the definite construct “outgoings of the border” as its subject. “serán salidas” keeps the subject of señalarán and makes salidas the predicate.
Proper noun plus directional suffix: “a” renders the suffix, and Tsedadá also keeps that suffix he on the name.

parked.spanish: Dos de las tribus y mitad de la tribu tomaron su heredad desde otro lado al Yarden Yerijó hacia oriente, hacia salida del sol.

findings.issue: מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן places the inheritance on the region-beyond relative to the Jordan. “desde otro lado al Yarden” resolves ל as allative and states a path from another side to the Jordan.

parked.spanish: Estos a los que mandó Jehová para heredar a hijos de Israel en tierra de Canaán.

findings.issue: Piel infinitive לנחל with את marks בני־ישראל as those acted on (given the inheritance). Spanish heredar is the subject inheriting, so hijos de Israel become what is inherited.
